hook: Barnyardgrass resists a herbicide by repurposing a cyanide-detox enzyme
summary: Resistance to cyhalofop-butyl in the weed Echinochloa crus-galli traces to a nitrilase gene, EcNIT4A2, that normally detoxifies cyanide. One amino acid change makes the enzyme break down the herbicide better, and a promoter variant raises its expression. Evidence comes from genetic mapping, transgenics and simulations in one species, and this is a preprint.
title: Evolution of herbicide resistance through co-option of an ethylene-associated nitrilase
